name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'justfile'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'justfile'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

jobs:
  generate-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: moonrepo/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          scope: '@oxc-project'
          architecture: x64
          cpu: 2

      - name: Enable corepack and install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate
        shell: bash

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        shell: bash

      - name: Generate Rust documentation
        run: cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: "-Zunstable-options --enable-index-page"
        shell: bash

      - name: Extract TypeScript definitions
        run: pnpm run build:types
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash

      - name: Analyze code structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/code-structure
          echo "Rust source files:" > artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          find src -name '*.rs' >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          echo "" >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          echo "TypeScript source files:" >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          find . -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          echo "" >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          echo "Node.js source files:" >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
          find . -name '*.js' >> artifacts/code-structure/structure.txt
        shell: bash

      - name: Extract configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/config
          echo "Cargo.toml:" > artifacts/config/config.txt
          cat Cargo.toml >> artifacts/config/config.txt
          echo "" >> artifacts/config/config.txt
          echo "package.json:" >> artifacts/config/config.txt
          cat package.json >> artifacts/config/config.txt
        shell: bash

      - name: Gather test information
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/tests
          echo "Rust tests:" > artifacts/tests/tests.txt
          find tests -name '*_test.rs' >> artifacts/tests/tests.txt
          echo "" >> artifacts/tests/tests.txt
          echo "Node.js tests:" >> artifacts/tests/tests.txt
          find . -name '*test.*' >> artifacts/tests/tests.txt
        shell: bash

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=(
            "Project Overview"
            "Development Workflow"
            "Code Conventions"
            "Testing Strategy"
            "Common Patterns"
            "Performance Considerations"
            "Debugging"
          )
          MISSING=()
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -qE "##\s*${section}" AGENTS.md; then
              MISSING+=("$section")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Missing sections in AGENTS.md: ${MISSING[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Package AI context bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts/ai-context
          cp -r target/doc artifacts/ai-context/docs
          cp -r artifacts/code-structure artifacts/ai-context/code-structure
          cp -r artifacts/config artifacts/ai-context/config
          cp -r artifacts/tests artifacts/ai-context/tests
          cp AGENTS.md artifacts/ai
